profile.bio: I'm a Frontend-focused Full-Stack Developer with three years of experience building production React and TypeScript applications for B2B and B2C products — from the UI through REST APIs and the PostgreSQL data layer, including authentication and claims-based authorization. I'm especially drawn to AI-powered products, shipping LLM features with validated, predictable output alongside measurable frontend and API performance gains.

facts.title: People think I'm very self-confident.
facts.body: I try to be, with small steps every day: learning new technology, asking new questions, failing, getting small wins, and going to sleep with a clear conscience.

facts.title: My favourites, in one line.
facts.body: Dish: ramen. Drink: coffee. Song: “Sex on Fire”. Movie: La La Land. Sport: football. Active sport: snowboarding. Season: spring.

facts.title: The latest technology I enjoy: n8n.
facts.body: I enjoy everything about it: the UI, the smooth transitions, the logic. Everything is clean and obvious, easy to learn and easy to work with. I host it locally, and it automates my job search, news collection, project improvements and more.

facts.title: What I'm embarrassingly bad at: games where you need to lie.
facts.body: Poker, mafia. It's hard for me to keep a poker face and not to blush. My friends say I'm an open book. I don't know if that's good or bad for me, but they find it refreshing.

facts.title: The strangest thing I learned out of curiosity: software development.
facts.body: I was a manager in the beauty industry. My whole life I was close to software development, but never in it. Then I tried it for fun, and it became my passion.

facts.title: At 16, I thought work was boring.
facts.body: I believed it could never give me good emotions. I was so wrong.

facts.title: What I've read recently.
facts.body: Technical: Grokking Algorithms. General: Don Quixote. It's shocking how much a book from 17th-century Spain still relates to our days.

facts.title: How I switch off from this reality.
facts.body: I cook, I take a walk, and I read love novels or science fiction.

facts.title: My guilty pleasure: love novels.
facts.body: I read them for fun, and no CV will ever say so. They always have a happy ending.

facts.title: My favourite place in the world.
What my friends would call my best habit.
My favourite quote.
facts.body: “Remember that sometimes not getting what you want is a wonderful stroke of luck.” — attributed to the Dalai Lama

sections.title: In short
body: This site has no accounts, no forms, no analytics, no advertising and no tracking. It does not load anything from other companies in your browser.

sections.title: Hosting by Vercel
body: The site is hosted by Vercel Inc. (USA). When you open a page, the server automatically processes technical data: your IP address, the date and time, the page you asked for, the page you came from, and your browser and device type. This is called a server log. It is needed to deliver the site and keep it secure. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR: my legitimate interest in a working and safe website.

Vercel processes this data on my behalf under a data processing agreement. Data may be processed in the USA. Vercel Inc. is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, and the agreement includes the EU standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: Cookies and storage in your browser
body: The site sets one cookie, called NEXT_LOCALE. It stores the language you are using (English or German). It contains no personal data and is deleted when you close your browser. It is needed to show the site in your language (§ 25 (2) no. 2 TDDDG).
The start page remembers within one browser session that its short intro has already been shown. This stays in your browser and is never sent to me.

sections.title: Fonts, scripts and project data
body: The fonts are stored on this site's own server. Your browser does not load fonts, scripts or images from other companies. The figures about my projects are fetched from GitHub by the server, not by your browser, so GitHub does not receive your visit.

sections.title: Links to other sites
body: Links to LinkedIn, GitHub, the demos and the sources I cite lead to other websites with their own privacy policies. They open in a new tab, and nothing is sent to them until you click.

sections.title: If you email me
body: If you write to me, I process your email address and your message to answer you. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR, or Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR if you ask about working together. My mailbox is provided by Google (Gmail). I delete messages when the conversation is finished, unless the law requires me to keep them.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You have the right to access (Art. 15 GDPR), correction (Art. 16), deletion (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection (Art. 21). Write to me at the email address above.

You also have the right to complain to a data protection authority. For me that is: Berliner Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit, Alt-Moabit 59–61, 10555 Berlin, mailbox@datenschutz-berlin.de.
